🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 13, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. From Libra, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Fire moves first and pays first. A week ago Mars was still held by Saturn; that is finished.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. From Virgo, Sun concedes the point early. Earth keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. Sun squares you from Virgo, and something has to give way. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. Four weeks ago Mercury was still in Leo: the ground has moved.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, moves through Libra unannounced. Sun in Virgo makes room for you, and then waits. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, is only passing through Virgo. From Libra, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. The Leo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Libra. Sun is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Mutable earth: the two accounts collapse into one. The conjunction to Sun that held two weeks ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Mars squares you from Cancer, and the cost objects. Air that starts things, billed for starting. The hold Saturn had three weeks ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Cancer, without leverage of its own. From Virgo, Sun hands you an opening. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. In four weeks Mars has moved 18°, small enough to feel like nothing.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Virgo, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Mutable fire: keeping options is the expense. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun in Virgo sides with you before you have argued. Earth moves first here, and first is enough. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Libra, Mercury agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Fixed air keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun faces you from Virgo: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Mutable water keeps two accounts open and pays both. Venus let go of it three weeks ago.
